The '''Chol Nebula''' was a relatively minor [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that partially engulfed the [[Cholganna system/Legends|Cholganna system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The nebula consisted of mostly gases but contained some [[Meteoroid/Legends|meteoroids]] or dust clouds which were dense enough to prevent [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] or [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] penetrating the area, making it especially dangerous to navigate. The nebula appeared to be a [[Color/Legends|crimson]] red color to those who viewed it in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The nebula slowly expanded, engulfing more of the Cholganna system as it did so. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]] passed through the nebula for approximately two thirds of its orbit of its [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] [[Cholganna system's sun|sun]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chol nebula first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
